create_AutoresearchPlatform: create an AutoresearchPlatform instance aggregating workspace, artifacts, execution, evidence, and agent capabilities
build_Artifacts_protocol: build an implementation of the _Artifacts protocol to compile or resolve experiment artifacts
test_Execution_protocol: test the _Execution protocol methods to launch, poll, and cancel experiment jobs
review_Workspace_protocol: review the _Workspace protocol for source-control operations like detect, commit, and goto
summarize_MetricsEvidence: summarize the _MetricsEvidence dataclass fields for system metrics, pipeline stats, and log paths
